description:
Cross-repository implementation handoff requested by user; this planning turn makes no application edits. Follow-up to completed extraction under zaq-0l7.24; do not reopen or duplicate completed storage work. Target: eliminate ZAQ SessionStorage protocol/setup facade by letting jido_chat_whatsapp request host storage through the existing sink_mfa with an explicit synchronous private request/reply contract. Engine retains encrypted Connect persistence, exact binding authorization, transactions, policies and NodeRouter dispatch. A sink event is a request, not a fire-and-forget saved notification.
Evidence: SessionStorage.runtime_spec/profile/prepare/connection_options/bind/document; adapter.connection_options -> Storage.Split.binding_options; Split.prepare/call/document_call already owns profile hashing, namespace routing, encoding, RAM checks. JidoChatBridge.from_listener currently enters State.process_listener_payload (GenServer.call); State sends outbound operations synchronously. Routing storage callbacks through State can deadlock State -> transport -> storage -> State. Storage prepare also precedes listener registration. New trusted request ingress must branch BEFORE State lookup and Jido.Chat message/action routing, work during bootstrap, and never use lifecycle dispatcher.
Ownership: package prepares profile/storage and requests opaque host binding/doc operations. Host injects immutable connector context, RAM-only and history policy; early sink handler validates adapter/request/capability, dispatches existing confidential credential_document Action. Payload IDs never confer runtime privilege. Keep confirmation persist/start authorization and pairing atomicity; explicitly migrate document callbacks supplied during authentication too. No Ecto, NodeRouter, grants, encryption keys or ZAQ-specific identifiers inside package logic.
Preserve response shapes :ok/:error/{:ok,value}/{:error,reason}, missing vs unavailable, ack-after-commit, generation fencing, stale binding rejection including RAM access, encoded document format, stable profile derivation, idempotent writes, no secret logging/tracing/history/queues. Bound deadlines coherently with Engine 5s transaction and current 6s RPC; retries after ambiguous timeout require idempotency/revalidation, never automatic stale-state overwrite. No SQL/data migration intended. Compatibility period must never issue both old and new writes.
The implementing agent must perform the coordinated package and host changes described below, following the child dependencies. Existing protocol callback contract may need a new shared Jido.Chat host-request envelope; decide in step 1 without overloading user ActionEvent. No new agent tool/workflow exposure. E2E: preserve existing pairing/restart journeys; reuse existing E2E; new journey authoring only if scope changes and UX approval gate applies. Final review/coverage/publication follow owner workflow; commit/push/release requires authorization.

Agent execution handoff:
- Beadwork owner is this ZAQ checkout. Track progress here for both repositories; start child .1, then .2, .3 and .4 in dependency order. Do not create duplicate plans or reopen completed parent extraction tasks.
- Package source repository: ../jido_chat_whatsapp, resolved relative to the ZAQ repository. Implement the reusable session/storage request contract, lifecycle preparation and package tests there. Do not leave the only copy of a fix in zaq/deps/jido_chat_whatsapp.
- Host repository: this ZAQ checkout. Implement the trusted early sink handler, reuse Engine credential_document dispatch, migrate authentication/runtime consumers, remove SessionStorage and add ZAQ integration regressions here.
- Read AGENTS.md in BOTH repositories before edits. In ZAQ also read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/engine.md (credential documents), docs/services/system-config.md (secret persistence/session state), and docs/documentation.md before documentation changes. Package contract owner: ../jido_chat_whatsapp/docs/adapter_contracts.md. Read affected module docs and inspect current Git state in both repositories.
- Preserve existing uncommitted WhatsApp PN/LID reaction normalization and ZAQ scoped_channel_rating_test/offline transport changes from this session. Preserve unrelated planning/report files. Never reset, overwrite or absorb unrelated work into this epic.
- Shared ../jido_chat changes are conditional on step .1 proving a shared callback/envelope contract extension is needed. Inspect its instructions first; keep host-specific semantics out of shared core. Prefer existing shared primitives where sufficient.
- New behavior requires package and ZAQ tests proving the real sink-to-Engine boundary. Include synchronous ack-after-commit, startup before State registration, outbound-send reentrancy, forged chat payload rejection, wrong binding/provider, revoked credentials, unavailable storage, RAM-only namespaces, profile stability and pairing handoff. Preserve existing data encoding and failure distinctions.
- Deliver reviewable changes in both source repositories with exact validation results, dependency compatibility requirements and deployment/rollback order. Record local path/mirrored dependency setup explicitly; a local cache edit is not a published dependency fix. Commit/push/merge/release remain unauthorized unless separately requested.
- Definition of done: SessionStorage removed; package owns provider setup/protocol state machinery; ZAQ retains only trusted policy/authorization/persistence routing; no storage request enters message history, generic action handlers or bridge State; required tests/gates pass or blockers are reported accurately. Do not broaden host authorization to mask protocol issues.
title: [zaq-0l7.24.12] Move session storage requests upstream across WhatsApp and ZAQ
